body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports a struct-literal field holding a freshly-constructed Result/Option value (a free widening reusing existing emit-call-arg dispatch). Found and fixed a real, pre-existing bug while verifying: a defstruct field with an explicit @ Region suffix has 5 children not 3, silently rejected by struct-field-shaped?'s old exact-3 check -- never exercised by any prior test. Widened to at-least-3, matching param-type-name's own convention. Also widened struct-field-c-type to recognize Result/Option as real struct field types. 7 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit e4e4afd.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: struct-literal Option field support + fixed a real region-annotation field bug
